node.statement: Multiplication. The exact source identity (XY)_jl=sum_{k=1}^2 X_jk Y_kl, bilinearity, and the compressed-product compatibility clause compare gamma_n(XY) with the sum of the eight compatible compressed products with total error at most a universal multiple of rho||X||||Y||. By def-compressed-corner each compatible compressed product differs from the ambient product by O(e); every incompatible ambient corner product is O(e) by the same left-right-compression and approximate-orthogonality calculation as in node 1.1.2. Expanding gamma_n(X)gamma_n(Y) into its sixteen terms therefore gives ||gamma_n(XY)-gamma_n(X)gamma_n(Y)||<=K_mult e||X||||Y||, with K_mult universal and independent of n.
